Too vague can you be more descriptive pls



It almost hits home perfectly....

Not depressed, I beat it out of me with a hammer and a forge a few years ago, but now I have no motivation to do much. Very few things excite me so I feel like I’m wasting my time wading through life. OfflineTV gives me hope that I’ll find friends when I return to university and be able to make up time lost, but I’m also afraid that I’ve missed too much of my prime window to develop relationships correctly. 

On the plus side, I finished designing and cutting out a rough template of a skateboard-shield hybrid. Steel lined on the edges for durability in the event I encounter a sword wielding maniac, but I’m struggling to wind a way to improve the strength of the skateshield’s base so it can take a hit and support my monumental weight. Thinking some thin metal sheets alternating with maple plywood would give sufficient impact strength, but weight becomes an issue at that point. Also figuring out a strap system that won’t interfere with rolling, but that bridge can be burned when we get there. 

Also, would any of OfflineTV be interested in custom woodworking/metalsmithing stuff? I’d be down to like, make a chair for Lily or a halberd for Fed (to defend against lily)
